title: UC6 loan 6 period-2 schedule interest (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing ONE period's interest of UC6 loan 6 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_NO_INT_RECALC_MULTIDISB_NO_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule transcribes the outstanding principal the period accrues on, periods[1].principalLoanBalanceOutstanding 803.97 -> "80397" minor units, annualInterestRate 12.0 -> 12, and the terms' declared day basis daysInYearType.id 360 / daysInMonthType.id 30. expect.interest_minor transcribes the period's observed interestDue 8.04 -> "804" minor units. The observed 8.04 is NOT a HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie (803.97*12*30/(100*360) = 804), so this vector corroborates the interest cell but does not discriminate the rounding mode (the pinned LN-L06 cell does). period 1 (2025-01-01..2025-02-01) straddles the 200.00 tranche dated 2025-01-15; its observed interestDue 12.00 happens to equal the formula on 1200.00, but the outstanding in that period is not constant (1000.00 then 1200.00), so it is a coincidental blend and is REFUSED. Period 2 accrues on the constant 803.97 and is transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion.
